description:
Position Overview

A Project Assistant / PhD Position (m/f/x) is available at the Institute of Electrical Power Systems, Graz University of Technology, in the field of Grid-Forming converters.

Responsibilities

  • Research into grid-forming control for power electronic converters
  • Investigation of dynamic grid interactions with the power grid
  • Development of simulation models for electrical grids using MATLAB/Simulink
  • Design and validation with hardware-in-the-loop systems
  • Preparation of specialist publications and a doctoral thesis
  • A one-year fixed-term contract with the option of extension

Admission Requirements

  • Master or Diploma Degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical Engineering

Desired Qualifications

  • In-depth knowledge of control engineering
  • Knowledge of modelling and simulating electrical power networks and energy technology components advantageous
  • Knowledge of network dynamics and stability advantageous
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop equipment advantageous
  • German is desirable; written and spoken English necessary

We Offer

  • Interesting area of responsibility
  • Collegial and friendly working atmosphere
  • Flexible working schedule (e.g. possibility for home office, paid lunch break - depending on working hours)
  • International training and teaching opportunities
  • Seal of quality for in-house advancement of women
  • Family-friendly employer
  • Subsidy for public transport
  • University's sports program
  • Shopping Discounts
  • Workplace Health Management
  • Top research infrastructure and access to the latest technologies
  • Exciting opportunities for professional and personal development
  • Safe and stable working environment
  • Company pension funds
  • Annual gross salary of at least € 52,865.40 for a fulltime position. An overpayment based on qualification and experience is possible.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Publication Date16 September 2026
Application deadline4 October 2026
Employment StartNovember 2026
Contract Duration12 months (with option of extension)
Hours per week40 h/w

Contact

Graz University of Technology, Rechbauerstraße 12, 8010 Graz

Application

Apply via the TU Graz job portal.

Official Link

https://jobs.tugraz.at/en/jobs/d0e399c4-7c7a-4943-adb7-c69dfc69c4b9

Important Notes

  • Graz University of Technology aims to increase the proportion of women and qualified female applicants are explicitly encouraged to apply. Preference will be given to women if applicants are equally qualified.
  • TU Graz actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities.
  • People with disabilities and who have the relevant qualifications are expressly invited to apply.
